C:P1.4.text: For over twenty years, Silvercrest has proudly served Individuals and Families, Institutional Investors, and Endowments & Foundations.

C:P1.6.text: Silvercrest: A Firm Committed to Excellence

C:P1.7.text: Our goal is to provide unparalleled advice to every client. Alongside our modern approach to portfolio construction, we offer the personalized service and open communication larger organizations can't, so clients feel confident and secure in choosing Silvercrest.

C:P1.8.text: Since our founding we have proudly served individuals and families with significant financial assets.

C:P1.9.text: Asset management is in our name. For over a decade, Silvercrest has partnered with select institutional clients to provide asset management, through our proprietary long-only equity management capabilities. We manage small through large cap value and growth equity, and international value strategies.

C:P1.10.text: Silvercrest partners with endowments, foundations and family offices to provide customized, full-service investment office solutions. The firm’s outsourced chief investment officer (OCIO) team leverages decades of experience managing nonprofits and family offices in tailoring portfolios to its clients’ distinctive financial goals, risk tolerances and mission objectives.

C:P1.11.text: In this issue of Insights, our team explores some of the most consequential forces shaping today’s markets and economy: the structure of the AI buildout, the philosophy of portfolio construction, and the geopolitical shifts reshaping how capital is deployed around the world.

C:P2.2.text: Silvercrest is a firm of talented financial service advisors who provide fresh thinking to the management needs of our clients and firm.

C:P2.4.text: We will always place our clients' needs first.

C:P2.6.text: We tailor solutions to each client's goals.

C:P2.7.text: We provide a comprehensive family office solution, leveraging our deep expertise in tax, estate, philanthropic, and concierge services.

C:P2.8.text: We integrate world-class proprietary portfolio risk analytics and reporting.

C:P2.9.text: Clients choose Silvercrest for our integrity, consistency, and proven record of success.

C:P2.10.text: At Silvercrest, we’ve built a team of talented financial advisors who provide unwavering service to our clients according to their goals. We listen, we ask questions, and once we know exactly what you want, we apply our deep financial expertise to help you meet those goals.
